title: Enrollment Terms of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
Riders of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons are added to a base contract under published enrollment terms: whether a rider can be added during a base term, the minimum days that must remain in the base term, the waiting period, whether the waiting period is waived when the rider is added with the base, how many of the same rider one base contract may carry, and which rider it cannot be held with.

## Enrollment terms

| Rider | Can be added mid-term | Minimum calendar days remaining in base term | Waiting period (calendar days) | Waiting period waived when added at base enrollment or at a real estate closing | Maximum of this rider per base contract | Cannot be held on the same base contract with |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 2 | none |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 1 | none |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 1 | none |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 1 | none |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 1 | Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 1 | Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | Yes | 60 | 30 | Yes | 1 | none |

## What the columns mean

- **Can be added mid-term**: whether the rider can be added during a base term.
- **Minimum calendar days remaining**: the minimum calendar days that must remain in the base term for the rider to be added mid-term.
- **Waiting period**: the calendar days after a rider is added mid-term before its items are covered.
- **Waiting period waived**: whether a rider added on the base enrollment date or at a real estate closing starts with the base coverage.
- **Maximum per base contract**: the maximum number of this rider on one base contract at a time.
- **Cannot be held with**: the rider that cannot be held on the same base contract at the same time; "none" means no such rider.

## Points of reference

**Which rider may appear twice on one base contract?** Only the Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider, up to 2 at a time. Every other rider is limited to 1 per base contract.

**Which riders exclude each other?** The Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider and the Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider each name the other.
